summary: Zammad is a Ruby on Rails open-source helpdesk / customer support & ticketing platform. It persists tickets and ticket articles, users, organizations, groups, roles and permissions, communication channels (email/SMS/Telegram/Facebook/WhatsApp), web chats, a knowledge base, macros, triggers, scheduled jobs, overviews, time accounting, checklists, and AI agents. Agents and customers create and act on tickets through a JSON API (REST + GraphQL). Tools kept in draft: 248. Auth: User (login/password).
